answer: Random peer audit: each work claim faces 5 auditors drawn at random from a grove of verifiers, so no attacker picks friendly judges. An auditor earns a plume only when its verdict matches the majority; a wrong verdict burns its 50-credit deposit. Forging 1,000 fake identities means 1,000 random audits, a dune of deposits worth 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 credits lost with no return. An honest agent pays once, passes once, and keeps its reward undiluted.
